candidate_material_re_derived_from_the_v.method: the view text was read at the pinned base commit; AST extraction over the view code records what the code binds (definitions, assignment targets, attribute targets and parameters), constants are the all-caps tokens, dotted versions and exception or type names appearing verbatim, and quoted strings are recorded separately because rule 1(c) admits them only outside the frozen stoplist
candidate_material_re_derived_from_the_v.correction_of_the_earlier_extraction: the first attempt of this pass recorded a docstring as a bound name and missed parameter names; that is fixed here, and it is the reason the material below differs from a naive name dump

django__django-15572.read_of_the_rev2_contract: required template_changed, BLOCK, COMMENT with cause=template_changed and fix=BLOCK: all three are code anchored (a defined name and two enum members bound in view 2), neither regex token is a keyword or builtin, so requirements 1 to 4 hold. Rule 1(c) is satisfied without leaning on a quoted string

django__django-16255.read_of_the_rev2_contract: required get_response, inner, request with cause=get_response and fix=inner: get_response and inner are parameters bound in view 1, request is a parameter bound in every view, and neither regex token is a keyword or builtin, so requirements 1 to 4 hold
django__django-16255.note_on_the_statement: the statement is about sitemaps and callable lastmod, which does not match this view set; the views and the contract are the selection branch's own material and the mismatch is recorded here rather than silently repaired, because repairing it would mean deriving different views

django__django-15569.the_rev2_rejection_is_wrong: rev2 rejected this candidate with 'no code anchored name could serve as the regex tokens' and 'a regex token is not code anchored'. Both regex tokens are in fact code anchored in view 1: `class RegisterLookupMixin:` is at line 152 and `def _unregister_lookup(cls, lookup, lookup_name=None):` at line 212 of django/db/models/query_utils.py at commit 884b4c27f506b3c29d58509fc83a35c30ea10d94, and both are inside the registered range 149-219. Requirement 3 is therefore satisfied on the verified source, and the rejection was mistaken

proposed_contract.why_the_third_literal_changed: the selection branch's third literal was `should`, which fails requirement 2 as a non code anchored common word. LOOKUP_SEP is bound in view 3 and is a constant token, so it replaces it and the contract keeps three code anchored literals

django__django-15569.why_this_candidate_is_the_best_of_the_th: its statement literally names both regex tokens - 'RegisterLookupMixin._unregister_lookup() should clear the lookup cache' - so the contract is anchored in the same place the statement is, which is what the rule asks for
